title: Actual private-provider record socket WRITE custody, source expiry and bounded exact acknowledgement
scope: Local macOS arm64, actual signed native EdDSA peers plus public HTTP ApplicationClient and one designated loopback HTTP/WebSocket provider. Actual native Session invitation/cancellation/discovery supplies the original metadata record. Trusted12KiB escaping metadata changes transport size only, with original audiences/epochs and canonical body below32KiB. No live captured media, real provider account, remote/browser/Linux or publication qualification.

production_change.behavior: Private initialization uses the existing512KiB provider-control socket limit rather than64KiB, so a valid bounded ContextView expanded by nested JSON escaping can receive its exact conversation-update acknowledgement. Raw32KiB context budget, exact ACK validation, original source/current authority and five-second IO maximum remain unchanged. Cleanup/default small socket remains64KiB. Upstream decoder already bounds control at1MiB; no upstream edit was required.

behavior: The positive case receives only the actual masked WebSocket length and16 payload bytes while the producer writes107989 bytes. Actual sender+receiver queues18402 plus a full negotiated segment/header slack640 are less than the outstanding frame both before and after a real authority writer queues. No complete export has reached the provider.

Public cancellation records intent before an independently authorized ApplicationClient exact RecordDelete queues. All-current-member read probes prove the writer reservation and deletion remains unfinished during partial IO and after the complete frame until the exact original ACK. Delivery is then recorded; deletion commits revision3 and immutable replay returns the original receipt.

The positive frame contains exact original UUID/Session/revision2/available state and a matching unsigned canonical SHA512 digest with source body below32KiB. Provider creation contains no record UUID. One creation, one export, one owned close, zero native consultation attempts and zero private provider audio; original consultation replay stays cancelled.

The separate expiry case uses the frozen original30sec metadata retention and begins export four seconds before its wire cutoff, earlier than the unchanged five-second IO maximum. No cancellation request is sent. Actual partial frame retires at source expiry; fewer than its declared bytes arrive, no complete provider export/delivery/native effect occurs and the queued Identity writer releases. The ledger and original logical replay remain failed.

After original source expiry, the independently owned retention sweep commits durable unavailability; fresh public HTTP fetch returns exact not-found. Source credentials remain current. Both cases independently observe usable original public native audio in both directions.
fixture_custody: Safe Unix nix descriptor inspection matches exact sender and receiver socket tuples before limiting only that sender buffer. Atomic duplicate descriptors are immediately closed, so instrumentation cannot keep a cancelled production socket alive.

Darwin uses lsof for the current test child PID and exact socket descriptors, reading producer queues before receiver queues to avoid undercounting transferred bytes. Overlap is conservatively counted twice; one complete negotiated MSS plus header slack remains outside the count. Linux proc implementation is present but has not been run.

A child process applies TCP_NOOPT before the designated127.0.0.1/port SYN via a test-only compiled C dyld interposer. It checks socket type and exact registered port, forwards original connect without address/application-byte changes and writes an option-application marker. Listener options are set through an owned socket passed only as child stdin. No host sysctl, production socket hook or Rust unsafe-code relaxation is used.

The two physical cases use the ordinary test thread stack and Tokio current-thread profile. Runtime C compilation and isolated child execution require local macOS development tooling. The90sec outer fixture bound does not alter source retention or production IO deadlines.
